verdict.rationale: Users can delete individual codes (docs-8), keep codes local-only by choosing "Use without an account" instead of cloud sync (docs-2), and choose which Google Account a code is saved to (docs-12). That gives basic control over where data is retained and lets users remove it. Community users note that exporting data outside the app is hard and that synced data is tied to the Google account's lifecycle, but this limits portability rather than contradicting deletion. Missing for 10: documented deletion of cloud-synced copies, any retention policy or controls, bulk deletion or account-level data wipe, and independent corroboration of deletion behavior.
